name: shiftexa-platform
description: SHIFTEXA AI Employee Marketplace & Business Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
